items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: Thelonious Monk I’m certain was not thought to be the next Art Tatum in his day. They probably thought he doesn’t sound like him, but he carved out his own thing.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m welcoming Jon Weber to campus. Welcome, on our 200th Anniversary.
As you can tell there’s a lot of stuff going on.
